feeds.title: Wheelchair Foundation
feeds.description: The Wheelchair Foundation is a nonprofit organization leading an international effort to create awareness of the needs and abilities of people with physical disabilities, promote the joy of giving, create global friendship, and deliver a wheelchair to every child, teen, and adult in the world who needs one but cannot afford one.

feeds.title: NMEDA Blog
feeds.description: In this Section, we discuss how people in wheelchairs live a normal life. National Mobility Equipment Dealers Association is the certifying body for the nationally recognized Quality Assurance Program (QAP) accreditation. We provide education & training to our members and partners.

feeds.title: Curb Free with Cory Lee
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Cory Lee. At the age of two I was diagnosed with Spinal Muscular Atrophy (type 2), but that certainly never diminished my desire to explore the world. This is my travel blog devoted to sharing the world from a wheelchair user's perspective. I hope to share my experiences as a disabled traveler with you and many tips as well.

feeds.title: Karma Medical Blog
feeds.description: Keep up to date with Karma's latest updates and descriptions of lightweight wheelchair users. we want to bring positive energy into the lives of all KARMA wheelchair users. We take action to help people with disabilities.

feeds.title: Wheelchair Daddy » Wheelchair life
feeds.description: In this category of my site, I write content related to how you can live a family life even though you are in a wheelchair. An Atlanta Dad Blogger sharing life and parenting experiences as a dad with cerebral palsy who uses a wheelchair as well as wheelchair tips, wheelchair accessories, wheelchair fashion, and the wheelchair lifestyle.

feeds.title: United Spinal Association
feeds.description: United Spinal Association is dedicated to enhancing the quality of life of all people living with spinal cord injuries and disorders. Directed by people with disabilities, United Spinal Association works to overcome the stigma of disability and remove physical barriers to inclusion for wheelchair users. United Spinal Association was founded in 1947 by paralyzed veterans returning from World War II.

feeds.title: ComfGO Mobility » Wheelchair
feeds.description: In this part of our blog, we describe how innovations in wheelchair mobility may help individuals who are disabled pursue ordinary and comfortable lives. Our Mission is to create solutions that will make people's lives easier.

feeds.title: Rollx Vans Blog
feeds.description: Rollx Vans offers handicap-accessible vans, wheelchair-accessible vans, and mobility vans. We are dedicated to providing you convenience, quality, and the safest, most reliable handicap vans in the industry! We work harder to make your life easier.

feeds.title: GRIT Blog
feeds.description: We blog about how an individual can travel while in a wheelchair to different parts of the world and enjoy life like an ordinary man. We believe in the power of movement and the opportunity to amplify one's self

feeds.title: Simply Emma
feeds.description: Simply Emma - one of the leading disability bloggers providing comprehensive reviews & advice on accessible travel. The blog was created to encourage others, with or without a disability, to travel more and make new discoveries, whether that's abroad or in their own hometown. It covers personal stories with accessible travel guides, accommodation reviews, live event reviews, travel tips, and resources.

feeds.title: Wheelchairliberty Blogs
feeds.description: We offer information about wheelchair-accessible vacation destinations and activities in our blogs. In order to simplify and ease your life, we also provide mobility tools. We aim to provide a memorable experience by offering quality products.

feeds.title: Jett Foundation
feeds.description: You can read our blogs to learn more about what it's like for people who use wheelchairs to lead fulfilling lives. Jett Foundation empowers people and families impacted by Duchenne muscular dystrophy through the development of transformative programming, educational opportunities

feeds.title: Have Wheelchair Will Travel Blog
feeds.description: At Have Wheelchair Will Travel, this family shares their travel adventures, tips, and day-to-day experiences. Recognizing travel as an occasional indulgence, they offer insights and fun tidbits beyond travel, catering to a diverse audience seeking inspiration and practical advice.

feeds.title: Spin the Globe
feeds.description: Spin the Globe creator Sylvia Longmire is a service-disabled veteran, mother, author, consultant, entrepreneur, world traveler, and the reigning Ms. Wheelchair USA 2016. Her mission is to share information about the accessibility of her destinations with fellow wheelchair users around the world and inspire them to explore the world around them.

feeds.title: The Wheelchair Skills College Blog
feeds.description: The Wheelchair Skills College is a Community Interest Company built on the belief that every person has the right to make the most out of life and knowing how to effectively use your wheelchair can enable you to do that. Our mission is to deliver high-quality, engaging wheelchair skills training sessions through which people build confidence and gain independence.

feeds.title: NovitaTech Blog
feeds.description: You may read about a variety of issues relating to the assistance and care of people in wheelchairs in our blogs. We offer a full range of services from assessment and prescription, to review, advice, and information regarding all different types of AT.

feeds.title: Assistive Technology Blog » Wheelchair
feeds.description: In this section of my blog, you can read content related to the innovation in wheelchairs, to make it simpler for the user. On the website, I write mostly about concepts/ devices that are still in prototype stages but would be possibly mass-marketed in the future. I also write about mobile apps/ software that makes life easier for people with disabilities.

feeds.title: Little Miss Turtle
feeds.description: Wheelchair Travel Blog covering wheelchair-accessible destinations around the globe. Find reliable accessible travel info written by a wheelchair traveler. Hi, I'm Melanie. In 2015, I started this wheelchair travel blog as a hobby to provide helpful advice for other disabled travelers like me.

feeds.title: Karma Mobility UK Blog
feeds.description: Read the latest blog entries by Karma Mobility UK. We provide lightweight wheelchairs, electric wheelchairs, Powerchairs, folding wheelchairs & accessories. KARMA Medical was established in 1987 with the aim of developing lightweight aluminum wheelchairs.

feeds.title: EZRide Plus Blog
feeds.description: We blog about how you can move around the streets more easily with the help of our EZ rides, and we also provide you advice on what to do and what not to do when using mobility aids. We build our products with ingenuity and care, and a keen eye for the human experience.

feeds.title: Motivation Blog
feeds.description: Motivation provides wheelchairs and services for disabled people in developing countries. The motivation was founded in the year 1991. We believe in helping to create a world where all disabled people are included and fully participate in every aspect of life.

feeds.title: BriteLift Blog
feeds.description: In our blogs, you can get BriteLift News, Updates, & Tips. We provide Safe, Easy, & Reliable Accessible Transportation In Chicagoland & SE Wisconsin. We focus on writing content about wheelchair-assessable travel and living a normal family life while in a wheelchair.

feeds.title: Wheelchair Travel
feeds.description: Hi, I'm John Morris founder of Wheelchair Travel. On this website, I have put forward a catalog of what I've learned while exploring the world with one hand, a passport, and my power wheelchair. In addition to writing about travel destinations.

feeds.title: The Bimblers » Accessible Travel
feeds.description: In this section, we write on how to make it easier to have accessible travel and on which locations you can travel to easily. The Bimblers is one of the UK's best blogs for wheelchair users. Hi, we're Rob and Bridget. The blog focuses on accessible travel and tips to help you live your best life with a chronic illness or disability.

feeds.title: Disabled Accessible Travel Blog
feeds.description: This blog is a guide for wheelchair-accessible travel with trending European destinations and insider tips & tricks. Disabled Accessible Travel was founded by Alan Broadbent in 2004 in Barcelona.

feeds.title: British Wheelchair Basketball
feeds.description: British Wheelchair Basketball is the governing body for wheelchair basketball in the United Kingdom. Our mission is to create, underpin and deliver quality opportunities for players at all levels in all corners of the United Kingdom to obtain the best possible performances for teams, clubs, and each and every member

feeds.title: Passionate People Invacare
feeds.description: Tips and real-world stories of living your life to the fullest with limited mobility. Invacare manufactures and distributes a comprehensive range of personal assistance products to help our users enjoy a comfortable, safe and active lifestyle.
